sloka: उभयोः अपि राजेन्द्र संबन्धेन अनुबध्यताम् ।इक्ष्वाकु कुलम् अव्यग्रम् भवतः पुण्य कर्मणः ॥१-७२-८॥
transliteration: ubhayoḥ api rājendra saṁbandhena anubadhyatām ।ikṣvāku kulam avyagram bhavataḥ puṇya karmaṇaḥ ॥1-72-8॥

translations.english: O King of kings (Janaka) the bond between your race with its pious deeds and the Ikshvakus may be strenghthened by this alliance".
